name: bit280
rule: about 2.80 bits per routed weight: gate and up at K2 in layers 3-22 and K3 elsewhere; down at K2 in layers 3-12, K4 in layers 48-52 and K3 elsewhere.

source: 5-layer blocks of gate and up, and of down, raised from K2 in order of the full-vocabulary KL they remove per byte, measured by a block sweep around a K3 profile and confirmed by measuring the profile itself. Shared experts as home.
